upstream.paper: CVPR 2025: Any-Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection by Spectral Learning

why_screened.independent_signal: self-supervised spectral reconstruction similarity rather than P0 line geometry or provenance metadata
why_screened.current_product_gap: A metadata-stripped complex normal AI-image smoke case was indeterminate after 125-percent scaling plus WebP Q80.

implementation_audit.official_hardware_statement: inference is documented for CUDA-capable GPUs with less than 8 GB GPU RAM
implementation_audit.code_observation: the published inference command exposes a CPU device option, but the normal evaluation/training paths call cuda directly and retain feature-extraction batches intended for GPU execution
implementation_audit.checkpoint_distribution: Google Drive link in the official README; no published cryptographic checkpoint hash was found in the checked source
implementation_audit.current_host_constraint: CPU-only inference must be isolated and memory-bounded because this host previously experienced an application crash during heavy Python work

decision.reason: The published weight is not hash-pinned locally and the official runtime is not yet demonstrated to fit this CPU host within an isolated memory/time envelope.
next_gate: obtain a complete checkpoint from the official source and record its cryptographic hash
run exactly one isolated CPU single-image resource probe with a strict timeout
only if the probe is safe, run a frozen cross-generator paired screen plus JPEG/WebP/screenshot-style transformed controls
keep its score outside product decisions until an independent threshold-calibration split is completed

scope: SPAI is a pixel/spectral candidate and does not validate P0 geometric candidates or provenance claims.
